vaccines.pattern: A coordination problem produces another coordination layer, which then requires more coordination.
symptoms: worker spends more turns administering Prometeo than doing work
control-plane work crowds out product value
vaccines.countermeasure: Map the failing transition; prefer deletion, fusion or server-side encapsulation; compare against simple baseline.

vaccines.pattern: Robustness is pursued by teaching every worker more of Prometeo internals.
symptoms: workers reason about leases/scheduler/routing rather than task
protocol mistakes despite strong task performance
vaccines.countermeasure: Move policy/runtime responsibility below the worker ABI; send only task-scoped context.

vaccines.pattern: Worker completes a task, then enters a separate discovery/re-entry phase to obtain another.
symptoms: worker decides it has finished the run
vaccines.countermeasure: Fuse acceptance and next assignment into SUBMIT_AND_NEXT when safe.

vaccines.pattern: A mature chat works because it remembers undocumented rationale, so fresh instances regress.
vaccines.countermeasure: Distill criterion, negative knowledge, authority and evidence into durable DNA/Canon; run fresh-agent test.

vaccines.pattern: A vivid TV/dashboard creates the impression the runtime is healthy.
symptoms: UI counts cannot be reconstructed from durable events
vaccines.countermeasure: TV consumes derived projections only; scientific result comes from event/receipt evidence.

vaccines.pattern: More handshakes/checklists are treated as inherently safer.
vaccines.countermeasure: Use transactional server semantics and machine checks; keep worker-facing protocol minimal.

vaccines.pattern: More workers are launched to compensate for assignment/continuation failures.
symptoms: busy chat count rises but productive units/launch does not
many workers fail before real WORK
vaccines.countermeasure: Hold scale; repair and benchmark the admission/assignment/continuation path first.

vaccines.pattern: A new memory/router/control plane is created without checking current Canon/Current/Lineage/Packets/Change Feed/Public State.
vaccines.countermeasure: Archaeology first; extend canonical owner rather than forking global capability.

vaccines.pattern: System over-invests in preserving one worker/chat identity.
vaccines.countermeasure: Persist logical slot/task/evidence; allow new incarnation.

vaccines.pattern: Producer marks its own work correct and aggregate DONE is treated as quality.
A run is repaired silently while measurements continue as if comparable.
vaccines.countermeasure: Freeze run version; any material patch starts a new run or marks run contaminated.

symptoms: system appears multi-agent but continuity depends on manual transport
vaccines.countermeasure: Durable shared state/returns/Guide Mesh; count every human routing action.

vaccines.pattern: A spec, queue, scanner or recovery policy is treated as proof of autonomous metabolism.
vaccines.countermeasure: Require exercised end-to-end receipts; unexercised remains DESIGNED_NOT_USED/PARTIAL/UNPROVEN.

vaccines.pattern: New architecture deletes the simple path before proving superiority.
symptoms: when regression appears there is no clean control
vaccines.countermeasure: Preserve last known good as runnable control until independent promotion.

vaccines.pattern: One exceptional worker/protocol is promoted as universal law.
vaccines.countermeasure: Independent reproduction gate and class-local conclusions.

vaccines.pattern: Worker protocol requires the model to execute or obey dynamic instructions returned by a connector/tool whose output is explicitly untrusted.
symptoms: bootstrap succeeds but worker refuses packet.instruction
workers join/lease then expire without submitting
behavior differs by safety enforcement despite identical runtime state
scaling increases pre-work and first-task failures
vaccines.countermeasure: Executable semantics must come from trusted user/system context. Tool output carries typed data only. Keep server-side scheduling/leases, but return fixture/context fields rather than imperative instructions; validate with one fresh-chat canary before scaling.
